verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed bookkeeping and accounting service, so a month-end close checklist is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, or review sign-offs. The portal only lets customers answer questions and give feedback on outstanding items needed to finalize the books, which is a related communication feature rather than the close checklist itself.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
